ENGLISH: With the dawn of the age of nationalism, revolution and liberalism, all of Islam must stand as one against the tides of modernity. We will summon representatives from all Islamic nations to an international congress, to propose our solution to these dangers. §RBeing the only Caliphate, having appeased the Shia muslims, and in general keeping the Islamic world strong will increase the chance of success during the congress.§!

The Greeks have been victorious in Anatolia, much to our dismay. No matter what they call themselves or what policies of coexistance they propose, they will always be foreign invaders of Islamic soil. The time has come to declare a jihad against Cappadocia, to call on all those who follow the one true faith to take up arms against the Christians!

The Sultan of Rum has strayed further and further from the true teachings of Islam. He is openly aligning himself with the forces of Europe, supports their decadent culture and does not heed our commands. He must be brought to heel.

The People of Assyria have sent us an emissary, begging the Caliph to intervene on their behalf in their war against Perisa. They claim that the Shia Persians treat the Sunni followers harshly, forcing them to work for less money, put restrictions on what land they may own, and cannot publicly support the Sunni faith. It has been hard to determine how much of this is true, and how much of it is purely falsehoods to convince us to help them. Regardless, the Persians follow the Shia faith and do not recognize us as legitimate Caliphs, which means that a strong Persia could be a problem for our continued legitimacy. On the other hand, if we wish to end the schizm between Shia and Sunni muslims an intervention would surely make that process more difficult.

The Persian government has recently come into conflict with the raiders from the steppes. We fear that the Khanate may prove victorious and conquer Persia, leading to a foreign ruler spreading his false religion across the Orient. At the same time, Persia could prove themselves an adversary to our Caliphate, so supporting them does not come without risk.

The Nation of Khorasan has recently been proclaimed. They claim that they intend to spread the word of the prophet to the non believers of India via conquest. Some would call it a pious proposal, others would call it a thinly justified landgrab. We could proclaim our support for their endeavour, legitimizing both it and their government, or we could stay silent on the matter.
